interpretationRule: The official Nepal 2026-07-30 supplemental registration/passport notice has been image-reviewed: application was extended to 2026-08-05 and expired passport details could be used for online first-phase registration, with a valid passport required at later employment application. These exact exceptions are specific to that cohort; other exact dates, documents, fees, medical/visa or test stages still require their own current-cohort official sources.

recruitmentRegistration.note: Nepal 2026 first-phase primary registration was 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-02; official July 30 supplemental notice expressly extended the end date through 2026-08-05. That application window is now closed.

crossSourceSchedule.rule: Use Nepal's July 30 supplemental notice as direct proof of the 2026-08-05 extension; HRD Korea's matching schedule is corroboration only. The 2026 first-phase window is closed, and the date cannot be copied to new cohorts.

passportSupplement.rule: An expired original passport number/details were accepted at initial 2026 online registration; a valid passport must be presented for the later Job Application Form after passing language and skill tests.

epsTopikSchedule.note: HRD Korea lists the 5th Nepal Manufacturing(5부) General CBT/Point System route with registration ending 2026-08-05; the Nepal July 30 official supplement independently verifies that extended registration deadline. The exam announcement and test period remain undecided.

epsTopikResult.note: No 2026 first-phase result notice has been promoted into KEP exact rules as of this check.

priorCycleEvidence.note: 2025 Manufacturing/Agriculture first-round passers received a Skill & Competency schedule for April 19–28, 2026. Those dates are not reused for the 2026 first-phase cohort.

medicalAndJobApplication.note: Stable process baseline is verified, but the 2026 first-phase cohort's current medical/provider/job-application notice remains required for exact dates, providers and submission instructions.

postSelectionVisaDeparture.note: Stable post-selection workflow is verified, including PDOT, CCVI/visa, FEIMS labor approval and final flight handling. Current-cohort exact instructions and volatile fees remain notice-gated.

processBaseline.note: Stable Nepal EPS workflow shape is verified for biometric, medical/police, employment application, roster, automated matching, SLC, PDOT, CCVI/visa and departure. This does not promote current 2026 first-phase cohort dates/providers/volatile fees.
processBaseline.currentCohortPromotionRule: A stable process-baseline fact may explain workflow shape, but exact current-cohort dates, providers, fees or submission requirements stay blocked until a current official cohort notice is reviewed.
processBaseline.feeRule: Historical baseline amounts may be retained for lineage only; they must not be displayed as current payable amounts when later official fee notices exist.
